messages:
jamal: Heads up — early-bird window for next Thu's webinar. Need a quick social plan for X + LinkedIn: 3 posts (tease, register, reminder) + an early-bird CTA rotation. Link: https://redwood.ai/webinar/early :sparkles:

alex: Got it. Can you drop the hero image and short copy we should A/B?

jamal: Copy roughs below, want short variations. Also need asset sizes: X card, LinkedIn link image, and a 9:16 short for stories.

alex: Sending two card options in a sec. Working file names: `hero_v1.png`, `hero_v2.png`, `short_9x16.mp4`

`tess: Copy variants — short and punchy:`
`- V1: "Ship LLM features faster — join our webinar. Early-bird seats open."`
`- V2: "Cut inference cost & latency: live demo + benchmarking. Save your spot."`
`- V3 (tease): "What 10ms latency actually looks like — demo Thu. Early access."`

sam: For X cadence I suggest:`
```
Day 0 (tease): 1 single image + CTA link (hero_v1)
Day 3 (register): thread on X with benchmark highlight + 2 replies (metrics + demo gif)
Day 6 (reminder): short video (9:16) + last-chance CTA
```

sam: Also propose rotating the early-bird link by UTM so we can route inbound leads to SDR queue A/B:
`utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_early&utm_content=variantA` vs `variantB`

maria: SDR routing notes: leads with utm_content=variantA => sdr-queue-east, variantB => sdr-queue-west. Add `?lead=true` param so webhook tags the contact.

jamal: Nice — can we automate link rotation per post? engage-bot / devops? :eyes:

engage-bot: @jamal I can generate two tracked links and a small rotation manifest. Paste desired base URL and two utm variants.

jamal: Base: https://redwood.ai/webinar/early ; variants: variantA, variantB. Generate and post in-thread.

engage-bot: Generated:
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/early?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_early&utm_content=variantA&lead=true`
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/early?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_early&utm_content=variantB&lead=true`

alex: Uploaded assets to /mkt/webinar/earlybird/: `hero_v1.png`, `hero_v2.png`, `gif_demo_v1.gif`, `short_9x16.mp4` — pinged creative drive.

jamal: Perfect. Tess — which copy goes with which asset? Keep A/B mapping in the doc.

`tess: Mapping suggestion:`
`- variantA (hero_v1 + V2 copy)`
`- variantB (hero_v2 + V1 copy)`
`Reminder: short video uses V3 tease copy.`

sam: I'll schedule X posts using Buffer later today. Also will thread the register post with a small benchmark card showing p50 latency and cost per token — need numbers from eng. @eng-ops can you drop a small stat?

jamal: I'll ping eng in #eng-runtime. For now assume p50=45ms, cost/token=$0.0008 for drafting the post. We'll update if eng gives different numbers.

maria: SDR play: when webhook receives lead param, create contact and set `source=webinar_early` and route by utm_content. Added runbook for SDRs at https://intranet/redwood/sdr-playbooks/webinar-early

jamal: Follow-ups: 1) alex finalize hero by 11am, 2) tess finalize copy + thread bullets, 3) sam schedule posts + confirm times, 4) eng to confirm p50/cost by EOD, 5) maria ensure runbook + webhook test.

alex: on it — will update file and tag here when done. :white_check_mark:

sam: Scheduling times I propose (PST): 10:00am tease, 11:30am register thread, 3:00pm reminder. Want to push the thread register at optimal engagement window — can shift if data suggests otherwise.

jamal: OK let's lock this. If eng numbers change, sam can swap the graphic in the scheduled thread. Thanks team :rocket:
